description: This Kotlin source file defines a Composable UI component called HomeRail for Android TV, using Jetpack Compose. It renders a horizontally scrollable, focusable section with a title and a row of cards, tailored for Android TV navigation, and contains layout calculations to match pixel-precision laid out assets.

methods.name: HomeRail
methods.description: A composable function that renders a focusable horizontal rail section with a title and dynamically sized cards, handling specific spacing for 'Seguí viendo' section.
